# NxtSteps

> NxtSteps builds automations and custom software that take the repetitive work off small teams: billing, follow-ups, data entry, reporting. You get the hours back.

## Services

- CRM & lead routing: new leads scored, routed and followed up automatically.
- Documents & approvals: proposals, contracts and reports generated from your data, with approval steps built in.
- Email & notifications: follow-ups, alerts and status updates that go out on time without anyone remembering.
- Spreadsheets & databases: live sync, formatting and dashboards, so the sheet updates itself.
- Connecting your tools: forms, spreadsheets, accounting, and payment tools working as one source of truth.
- Reporting & data pipelines: numbers collected, cleaned and reported automatically.

## Tools used

Zapier, n8n, Power Automate, Google Apps Script, Excel VBA, QuickBooks, custom code. The tool is picked to fit the business, not the other way around.

## Process

1. Audit: process analysis and automation roadmap.
2. Blueprint: the plan, including any software purchase needed, flagged before committing.
3. Build: typically live in 1-2 weeks, with testing, documentation, and 30 days of support.
4. Monitor and optimize.

## Offer

- Free 30-minute discovery call first.
- Workflow Audit: $250 one-time, after the free call.
- Build & Launch: $2,500+ per project.
- Retainer: $499 per month.

Clients own their data. NxtSteps owns none. The goal is not to add to the client's tech stack, but a software purchase is sometimes still needed.
